metadata.title: AgentCE Agent Conformance Engine — OSCAL component definition

components.title: AgentCE assessment engine
components.description: A deterministic, model-free engine that assesses recorded agent evidence against an executable control catalog and emits assertions, an OSCAL assessment result, SARIF, and evidence packs (SPEC §5, §9).

control-implementations.description: The controls of the EU AI Act base catalog that the engine evaluates. Each implemented requirement names one catalog control; obligation crosswalks to regulatory and standards clauses live beside the catalog under crosswalk/.

implemented-requirements.description: AgentCE evaluates control DAT-01 (Consequential decisions record the data they consumed) against recorded evidence and reports a per-control OSCAL finding with the outcome and evidence pointers.
